source_evidence: The hypothesis is expressed in current source, verified directly: the TRIED note at src/flic.cpp:676-700 records the full structural description - the image reads the line header at one site (0x0062A7C7) entered by both back edges (skip-path jmp 0x0062A7B7 at 0x0062A804, line-tail jl 0x0062A7B7 at 0x0062AA8C) with eight fread sites, while VC6 in this tree rotates the cycle and emits two cloned sites; seven spellings measured 2026-09-17 across both campaign flag sets (decks flic-delta-loopmerge and flic-delta-continue plus local compiles) plateau byte-identical at 1008/960, the Buffer local reaches 992/944, and the single-site continue-merge lands at 928/912-944 with divergent register allocation (kdb 1633 vs the baseline 864), so the note retains the current while spelling as the closest measured form.

The relevant implementation is the real product body, not a seed or planned repair: Flic::decode_delta_flc at src/flic.cpp:704-816 implements exactly that retained closest form, spelling the line-header fread at the loop head (src/flic.cpp:735) and the skip re-read (src/flic.cpp:739); the working-tree file SHA-256 a39a65395460ff2d30c937313be7257a75bf93e050232a9fc9a291b3492776a2 matches the request's mapped source record for entity-356fc181efee0a59fe11c746c433d866536569295c0dd8ad29d98dac106e7520.

Fresh diagnostics corroborate the plateau rather than refuting it: the scoped binary check on this unchanged request measures decode_delta_flc 0x0062A720 fail by extent only - candidate 1008 bytes under /c /O2 /Gy /GR- /GX /Z7 and 960 under /Oy- against the independently recorded 967-byte original extent - with nine _fread relocation sites (section offsets 110/175/245/443/490/549/600/636/739) versus the image's eight, exactly the duplicated line-header read the note documents; bytes and references report unknown with no other measured divergence, and the referenced component_verification, generated_tables, shared_functions, layout coverage and recheck_entities arrays contain nothing bearing on this entity.

No obligation, baseline or claim is demoted: entity-356fc181efee0a59fe11c746c433d866536569295c0dd8ad29d98dac106e7520 is a subject of flic-decoder-recovery and carries no protected byte obligation; the twelve protected obligations (constructor 0x00629D60, close 0x00629DF0, decode_frame 0x0062A070, rewind 0x0062A280, UNK2/UNK4-UNK9 and ~Palette 0x005FE2E0) all measure pass and are untouched, and the ORIGINAL marker at src/flic.cpp:669-670 preserves the 0x0062A720-0x0062AAE7 identity with its 967-byte extent under both fixed flag sets.

The resolution ground is source expression verified against the unchanged request file (SHA-256 8517205518f2d29588df2ec6c6015ac031c786bbb094bbae1c5b5888a6ee3637), not a passing checker or run budget: the extent failure remains recorded as a diagnostic in the binary check, consistent with the task intent that byte mismatches remain diagnostics rather than goals, and with the framework's 2026-09-17 flic coordination position that diagnostic entities whose residual is compiler-side with no source lever under the two fixed flag sets are resolved within the flic task files once their structural description is expressed in current source.

Other actions do not fit this finding: its affects list names only the in-scope entity above, so expand or route would grant unneeded scope; the hypothesis is already measured to have no source lever under the two fixed flag sets, so investigate or investigate_local would only re-measure the same plateau; and the evidence corroborates rather than refutes, so reject is unwarranted.
